about_the_game:
Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game where you play as a vampire lady, strategically switching between her vampiric and human forms. Engage in high-speed life-or-death combat using blood as your ultimate resource.

To find your long-lost sister, you must obey a mysterious broker and navigate a conflicted world. At the end of this bloody path lies your sister, a conspiracy, or... maybe hope?

“Pure Blood” Combat

Dual Forms​​: Blood is power! The bloodthirsty Scythe Form consumes HP for swift kills, while the tactical Cane Form allows HP recovery and stun.

Focus & Skills​​: Unleash stylish yet practical attack skills to overwhelm enemies with relentless combo chains.

Relentless Foes​​: Enemies track you across terrain and will relentlessly pursue you once combat begins.

Break & Execute​​: Shatter enemy defenses through skill combos, then deliver instant-execution finishers.

"Blood-Tears" Story

While searching for your sister, you receive a message from an enigmatic broker. To uncover her whereabouts, you must accept broker's missions.

In a modern world torn by human-demon race conflict, you – a vampire – confront brutal realities.

The broker, your sister, gangs... This isn't just about them.
This is also about you, and... yourself

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all age groups or is not appropriate to access during work hours: frequent violence or bloodshed, common adult content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio devices
  • Additional Notes: Supports mechanical hard disk (HDD), and recommends using solid state drive (SSD).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio devices
  • Additional Notes: Supports mechanical hard disk (HDD), and recommends using solid state drive (SSD).

short_description: Vampiress: Eternal Duet is a noir-style 3D side-scrolling action game. You play as Miss Vampire who switches between vampire/human form and uses blood to fight in high-speed battles. To find your sister in this conflicted world, bloodshed is the last thing to worry about...
